name: Payment of Funeral Assistance for the Construction Workers
targetBeneficiaries: Nominees of deceased registered construction workers
Dependents of deceased registered construction workers
Spouses of deceased registered construction workers
briefDescription: This welfare scheme offers financial assistance for funeral expenses to the nominees or dependents of a deceased registered construction worker or their spouse.
descriptionMd: The "Payment of Funeral Assistance for the Construction Workers" is a crucial welfare scheme implemented by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD. It aims to provide essential financial support during a difficult time. The scheme ensures that the nominees or dependents of a deceased registered member, or their spouse, receive assistance for funeral expenses.
eligibilityMd:
- The deceased must be a registered member of the BOCW Welfare Board.
- The applicant must be a nominee or dependent of the deceased registered member.
- The scheme also covers nominees or dependents of a deceased spouse of a registered member.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
